project: Titanic real-photo-first passenger and crew documentary director cut

shots.editorial_why: Authentic ship departing Southampton establishes actual day and ship, not an imagined passenger port.
Only a sourced route diagram can accurately connect Southampton, Cherbourg and Queenstown in one beat; disclosure mandatory.
Period dining setting matches first-class accommodation and amenities; original caption must be checked.
Genuine meal document is primary evidence of onboard first class service, not a fabricated dining table.
Accurate source-attributed count must be shown with numbers rather than a misleading anonymous passenger crowd.

shots.onscreen_label: 1912 REPORTED PASSENGER NAMES / NOT A COMPLETE OFFICIAL ROLL
shots.editorial_why: Actual April 17 newspaper listing captures challenge of counting 1912 passengers, not an unquestioned exact total.

shots.onscreen_label: A CREW OF DIFFERENT TRADES / SCHEMATIC
shots.editorial_why: Crew roles can be illustrated as a labelled hierarchy; shipyard construction workers must not be misrepresented as ship's crew.

shots.onscreen_label: SECOND OFFICER LIGHTOLLER AND FIRST OFFICER MURDOCH / 1912
shots.editorial_why: Actual period image of Titanic officers aboard before voyage; clear photo origin and no Olympic misidentification.

shots.onscreen_label: CAPTAIN EDWARD J. SMITH / HISTORICAL PORTRAIT
shots.editorial_why: Real photo of the commander named in script, not an anonymous cartoon officer.

shots.onscreen_label: FIRST OFFICER WILLIAM MURDOCH / HISTORICAL PORTRAIT
shots.editorial_why: Distinct dated portrait of named officer from the bridge hierarchy, not fictional uniform/act.

shots.onscreen_label: THE ACTUAL MUSICIANS / COLLAGE PUBLISHED AFTER SINKING IN 1912
shots.editorial_why: Original photographs published in 1912 after disaster identify Titanic musicians; NOT a performance photograph on deck.

shots.onscreen_label: THE LAST PIECE PLAYED IS DISPUTED
shots.editorial_why: No evidence photo can resolve uncertain last tune; original clear evidence-versus-myth diagram is necessary.

shots.onscreen_label: PASSENGER LANGUAGES AND ACCESS / NOT A DEMOGRAPHIC MAP
shots.editorial_why: A labelled original route-and-language schematic, not a fabricated scientific count.
Genuine US immigration record illustrates international travellers and survivors, explicitly dated after rescue.

shots.onscreen_label: THE SHIP FROM SOUTHAMPTON / BEFORE ATLANTIC CROSSING
shots.editorial_why: Genuine photo of the Titanic before crossing is relevant to expected New York arrival.

shots.onscreen_label: ADVERTISEMENT FOR TITANIC'S MAIDEN VOYAGE / 10 APRIL 1912
shots.editorial_why: Genuine historical voyage advertising reflects passenger expectation of a transatlantic voyage, not a modern fake passenger list.
